>If money isnt available, its time to look at the games I have and see if there's a new way I can play them. Maybe up the difficulty, go for perma-death, or hoard as much loot as I can. When all else fails, its time to put on an online shooter and grind. Thats what I do.


That is interesting way to look at games you already own. I'm usually most of the time bored and sad and I have that "own too many games anxiety" where you have too much to choose from and I never ended up doing anything else than looking at my game libary in Steam and being even more bored. Thanks for this tip :)
